checks.what: samarra-culture gain from ubaid-period at -4900, region Samarra 110 km + As Sulaymaniyah 90 km (the dossier's own keyframe/found spec; resolves to 249 cells, about 63,000 km2). Anchors data/anchors-c/m5100: Samarra holds all 249; m5000, m4900 and m4800: Samarra 206, Ubaid 43; m4700: Ubaid 249 (the -4800 Samarra dissolve to ubaid-period). The gain therefore moves exactly 43 cells for -4900..-4801 and changes nothing from -4800 on. Page support: the Samarra culture page gives "c. 5500 - c. 4800 BCE" and names Samarra, Tell es-Sawwan ("middle Tigris, near Samarra"), Tell Shemshara and Yarim Tepe, and says "It partially overlaps with Hassuna and early Ubaid". The Ubaid page says "In central and northern Iraq, the Ubaid culture was preceded by the Hassuna and Samarra cultures". It also names "a complete Ubaid settlement at Tell Abada" in the Hamrin, but gives it no date. The restoration is a cartographic one and the year is the window start; the note says so. The effect is sound, but the window agent's justification was wrong. The ubaid-period_-5100 keyframe does NOT subtract these cells. It subtracts the Samarra circle from its northern (Jazira/Assyria/Aleppo) part only, and its resolved shape contains exactly these 43 cells. 32 of them lie in the Babylonia region (Diyala 31, Baghdad 1; 29 of these in the Samarra circle) and came in by the -5100 keyframe snap. 11 lie on the western rim of the As Sulaymaniyah circle (At-Ta'mim/Kirkuk 7, Erbil 3, Salah ad-Din 1) and came in by the -5100 gain from the Halaf. None is in Sulaymaniyah province, so the report's 'Sulaymaniyah plain with Tell Shemshara' is wrong. Restoring the cells to the Samarra culture is still consistent with three things. The Ubaid keyframe text keeps the middle Tigris Samarran "until 4800 BCE". Its note calls the Sulaymaniyah overlap "a region boundary, not a claim". The Ubaid ledger gains the Samarra circle from samarra-culture only at -4800. Against it: the Ubaid dossier's notes keep the 29 Samarra-circle cells inside Babylonia as Ubaid land from 5500 BCE. The draft never drew that, because Samarra held them -5500..-5101. check-patch: ok.
